messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

Siraz, I'm sorry. Your order was due to ship on November 14 and it didn't, and you've been waiting since September 12.

Your Harlo B30 (order Shop····) now ships with the batch scheduled for November 30. That answers your question from yesterday. Your Power K. is already set aside at our Tennessee warehouse and goes in the same box. Tracking comes to (email hidden) as soon as it ships. You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
